cancel.title: Cancel this subscription?
cancel.description: The Stripe subscription is cancelled, entitlements are republished and the workspace owner is notified. A trial ends immediately; a paid subscription runs to the end of its period.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this subscription?
reactivate.description: Undoes a cancellation that has not taken effect yet: renewal is switched back on for the period already paid for. Nothing is charged now. It does not lift a service suspension.

lifecycleDialog.reasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least ten characters. It is the only record of why.

changePlanDialog.title: Change plan
changePlanDialog.description: Moves this workspace's subscription from {planName} onto the plan you choose. The credit balance does not move with it — compensate separately with a credit adjustment if the change warrants one.
changePlanDialog.genericError: The plan could not be changed.
